personas.name: Caterer Manager
personas.short_description: Posts surplus food after an event in about a minute, confirms the pickup, and reads the weekly impact report.
key_responsibilities: Post surplus food by free text, voice or form
Confirm the AI-filled listing before it is posted
View the handling card with consume-by time, storage, allergens and disclaimer
Follow live listing status through to Delivered
Cancel a listing while it is Posted
Receive the weekly impact report for clients

personas.name: NGO / Shelter / Community Kitchen Coordinator
personas.short_description: Receives ranked offers, accepts the food they can serve in time, and confirms servings received on delivery.
key_responsibilities: Receive ranked offers, each with a plain-language reason
Accept an offer, which assigns a volunteer with an ETA
Read the handling card with allergens and consume-by time before accepting
Confirm servings received on delivery
Flag a mismatch at pickup or report a problem with a donor

personas.name: Volunteer Driver
personas.short_description: Takes nearby pickups in free time, enters the donor's handover code at collection, and delivers the food.
key_responsibilities: See nearby pickup tasks assigned to them
Enter the donor's one-time handover code at collection
Update status as the food is collected and delivered
Receive the exact pickup point once assigned

personas.name: CSR Sponsor
personas.short_description: Reviews verifiable impact totals by zone and quarterly summaries to decide funding and report on it.
key_responsibilities: View impact totals by zone on the sponsor dashboard
View impact of each rescue with its stated assumptions
See the assumption version used for each number
Review quarterly summaries for sponsored zones

personas.name: Internal Platform Admin
personas.short_description: Onboards receivers and volunteers, verifies FSSAI registrations, reviews flagged listings and maintains versioned assumptions.
key_responsibilities: Add people who use the app and give them roles
Onboard receivers and verify their FSSAI registration
Review flagged listings and locked handovers
Edit assumption values and rule tables with versioning
Deactivate accounts
